name: Harpy Lieutenant Ring
summary: In the Dry Hills, Harpy Lieutenant Rings mark the Witchwing Slayers who command the flock. Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads asks for them as proof of death.

sections.title: Tokens of Rank
sections.body: Witchwing Slayers direct attacks on Horde travelers in the Barrens. Their rings mark their place among the flock’s leaders, above the ordinary raiders who fight with little coordination. At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger and the defenders need the rings taken from fallen slayers to confirm that this part of the harpies’ leadership has been broken.

faq.answer: Witchwing Slayers wear the rings as lieutenants among the Witchwing flock in the Dry Hills.

faq.q: Where can Witchwing Slayers be found?
faq.answer: Witchwing Slayers roost in the Dry Hills, northwest of the Crossroads in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Darsok Swiftdagger want them?
faq.answer: Darsok wants the rings as proof that the Witchwing Slayers have been killed. Their deaths break part of the flock’s leadership.

faq.q: Do regular harpy raiders carry these rings?
faq.answer: No. The rings mark the Witchwing Slayers, while ordinary harpy raiders are lower-ranking underlings.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face Witchwing harpies that harass supply lines between Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern outposts. Breaking their leadership helps secure passage for Horde caravans across the Barrens.
As a rogue, you may favor the precise strikes Darsok Swiftdagger seeks: slipping into harpy roosts to kill their commanders.
